messages:
maya: Planning to flip the flag `router_v2_enable` from `off` -> `on` as a progressive rollout starting with 5% canary on 2026-03-20 18:00 PT. Need smoke owners, rollback steps, and confirmation that the safe-default (no routing change) is stable. Plan: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 50% -> 100% if all checks pass. Anyone object?

jonathan: +1. I can own the deploy and watch the rollout in Console. I'll run the smoke scripts and verify traffic split.

kevin: I can be on alerts. Recommend adding a quick synthetic to verify p99 route latency and 4xx/5xx rates during canary. If errors spike >0.5% over baseline we rollback.

maya: Good call. Kevin, can you add the synthetic now and set an alert to post here?

kevin: Doing it now. ETA 8m. Alert: `router_v2_canary_error_rate` threshold 0.5% (5m window). Will post when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy job created by @jonathan: `deploy router_v2 --env=prod --strategy=canary --percent=5 --meta=flag-rollout-1902007654`

jonathan: Smoke checklist I'll run after the flag flip:
```
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env prod --path /health
./scripts/check_qps.sh router_v2 1m
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.prod.example.com/v2/route/test
```
Please ping here when smoke is green.

drew: I'll take logs and traces. If I see any spike in 5xx or auth failures I'll post teardown steps. I can also flip the flag off in Console if needed.

maya: Rollback plan spelled out: 1) Flip `router_v2_enable` -> `off` (console) 2) Run `deploy-bot rollback router_v2` if flag flip doesn't stabilize traffic 3) Re-open postmortem thread and attach smoke results. Agreed?

kevin: Agreed. Also suggest we keep the canary payload lightweight (no heavy batch jobs) and exclude internal traffic: `exclude_tag: traffic=internal`.

jonathan: Noted. I'll use the deploy flag config: `--exclude-tag=internal` and will document the exact command in the runbook before executing.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Canary start in 1h 20m (2026-03-20 18:00 PT).

drew: I'll be on rotation during the window and will watch SLO dashboards. Posting the dashboard links here once I have them.

kevin: Synthetic and alert are live: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/router-v2-canary. Alerting to #eng-platform and paging to oncall if threshold breached.

maya: Perfect. Last check — safe default behavior means any request that would hit router_v2 but is not matched will fall back to router_v1, correct?

jonathan: Correct — the runtime uses `fallback: router_v1` when feature routing rule doesn't match. I double-checked the config.

maya: OK let's proceed. I'll flip dev flag for a quick test in staging now. Will post the staging smoke result in 10m. :thumbsup:

jonathan: Ready on my side. I'll start the production canary at 18:00 and post updates here every 5–10m during the first 30m.

maya: Thanks all — appreciate the quick sync. If anyone changes the plan tag me.

jonathan: 18:00 PT - starting canary now. Flipped flag to `on` for 5%.

deploy-bot: Canary step applied: `router_v2_enable=on (5%)` by @jonathan at 2026-03-20T18:00:03Z

jonathan: Running smoke checks...

jonathan: Smoke: 200 OK on health, qps steady, no increase in 5xx.

kevin: Grafana shows error rate within baseline. No alert.

drew: Traces look clean, no auth regressions.

maya: OK moving to 25% in 10m if nothing changes.

jonathan: Increasing to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Canary step applied: `router_v2_enable=on (25%)` by @jonathan at 2026-03-20T18:12:45Z

jonathan: Smoke again: all green. No action.

maya: Great job everyone. Final 50% and 100% tonight at 19:00/20:00 PT unless we see anything. I'll open the post-rollout note after 100%.

kevin: Will keep watching the alert. If anything, will flip flag off and post rollback steps.

maya: Closing here, will update thread with postmortem link once rollout completes. :white_check_mark:
